{#- Local override of the sphinx-book-theme sidebar navigation. Goal: show the numbered sections of every command page (its feature list) as a tree in the left sidebar, so a visitor sees at a glance what CrystOD can do. The stock template calls pydata-sphinx-theme's generate_toctree_html(), which deliberately removes every sidebar entry whose link carries a "#" anchor (pydata/toctree.py: "Remove sidebar links to sub-headers on the page") -- in-page sections can therefore never appear through it. We call Sphinx's own toctree() template function instead, which returns the plain nested
    including the section anchors; the theme's own CSS styles it, with a few rules for the section level added in _static/sidebar-tree.css. Kept in sync with sphinx_book_theme 1.2.0 (theme/sphinx_book_theme/components/sbt-sidebar-nav.html). -#}
